analogy.rationale: PTAFR is a G-protein-coupled receptor with very low expression in most of these cell lines, so PTAFR antagonists should produce little transcriptional response; other lipid-mediator GPCR antagonists (leukotriene, prostanoid, thromboxane) are the closest functional analogs but also act on receptors with limited expression in these cells.
